summary_en: 100,000 shares (0.05% of S/O) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 27 July 2026 at ¥3,574/share, maximum aggregate ¥357.4M. Executed as single-session order during morning ToSTNeT-3 trading window. Results to be announced after market close.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Treasury Share Repurchase via Off-Session Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Canon Marketing Japan announced on 24 July 2026 that its board has authorized a single-session treasury share repurchase to be executed on 27 July 2026. The company will acquire up to 100,000 shares (0.05% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) via off-session trading (ToSTNeT-3) on the Tokyo Stock Exchange at the day's closing price of ¥3,574 per share, with a maximum aggregate outlay of ¥357.4M. The repurchase order is limited to the morning trading window (8:45 AM start) and will not be carried over to other sessions or times. Execution results will be announced after the close of trading on the same day. The company stated the purpose as enhancing shareholder returns and improving capital efficiency. As of 30 June 2026, the company held 16,164,369 treasury shares against 205,995,575 shares outstanding (ex-treasury).
